title: The Inspector surface check reads code, not comments, through the shared gate stripper

installed_sdk.rationale: A repository check script and its test only: no header, target, or installed artifact changes.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: No CLI verb, flag, handler, or document shape changes; the check that pins the reduced inspect surface keeps its verdicts.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: No MCP tool definition, schema entry, or handler changes.

live_product_control.rationale: No capability, operation, executor binding, grant, or profile policy changes.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: docs/status/agent-capabilities.json is unchanged; the check's comment handling is CI tooling, not a design-time capability.
